text:
radha: Noticed a weird pattern: agg-hours shows a gap where hourly_count is fine but percentiles are off for the same window (05:00-08:00 UTC). Suspect late events were ingested but shard-mapper dropped some keys.
tom: Did the ingestion logs show any partition reassign around that time?
radha: Yes, coordinator moved a partition during a spike. Shard mapping lagged ~7m and some events ended up in the wrong partition TTL path.
kai: So we have late events present but compute skipped them. We should run a compute-only replay to recompute aggregates without re-ingesting. That avoids dedupe issues.
devex-zoe: Console doesn't expose a compute-only flag today. We have replay-api flags: full_replay, dry_run, priority. Could we add compute_only param for operator runs?
radha: For this incident let's use the internal admin endpoint that can re-run aggregation for a time slice. It's limited to ops tokens.
replay-bot: automated: admin-agg-queue capacity = 3. Recommend 1 slice at a time.
tom: Plan: 1) run compute-only dry-run for a 30m slice (05:30-06:00 UTC) to confirm diffs; 2) if diff <1% skip; if 1-3% run full recompute for that hour, staged; 3) monitor tile/dashboard main KPI and tracing.
kai: Need to capture correlation_id in trace so we can link the compute job to the original ingest event ids. Also ensure debug logs don't contain raw payload.
devex-zoe: I'll add a temporary console toggle "compute-only" under advanced options and surface a small note about operator-only tokens. UX will show job id and link to trace.
radha: curl for dry-run compute-only: curl -X POST "https://internal-api/admin/agg-recompute" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"start":"2024-06-12T05:30:00Z","end":"2024-06-12T06:00:00Z","dry_run":true,"compute_only":true}'
tom: After dry-run, export a diff table to S3 and run the compare job. If any shard-level diff > 2% we'll pause and open a paging channel.
replay-bot: automated: dry-run queued (id=rb-1705019999-agg-dry). ETA ~90s.
radha: dry-run done: sample diff for that slice shows +1.9% on p95 and +0.2% on counts. Looks like compute missed tail latencies.
kai: OK run staged compute for the full impacted window in 30m chunks, priority=low, concurrency=1.
devex-zoe: Pushed console change (flag only visible to ops) and added job link. Will follow up with a tiny doc.
tom: Also add a temporary dashboard panel comparing ingest vs compute counts and p95. If mismatch ratio > 1% for 2 slices in a row, auto-pause the queue.
radha: Kicking off slice 1/6 now (job id rb-1705019999-agg-1). Posting updates.
replay-bot: automated: admin-agg-queue available tokens now 2. Current running jobs: 1.
radha: slice 1 complete, shard diffs within threshold. Proceeding to slice 2.
radha: slice 2 complete, hit a shard with 3.5% p95 diff, pausing. Escalating to infra for a shard-state check.
tom: Opening incident channel #ops-agg-recompute now and inviting infra.
devex-zoe: Keeping console job visible and annotating paused reason. Will patch runbook to advise compute-only when mapping reassigns occur.
radha: saving all request_ids and traces into ticket. Follow-up action items: add compute-only flag to public replay API (devexp + security review), add auto-pause rule on dashboard, update runbook.
